# The second question finds the finding

In practitioner interviews, the first answer is the rehearsed one; the finding almost
always arrives after the follow-up question that asks for the specific incident behind
the general claim. Budget interview time for follow-ups rather than coverage, and
transcribe the incident details verbatim while they are being told — the specifics
that make a finding checkable are exactly the ones memory smooths away by the
afternoon.
